meta.note: XGBoost is implemented and reported alongside, but the calibrated logistic model measured better out-of-sample on this dataset.
meta.validation: walk-forward by season (train on all prior seasons, test on the next)
meta.data_source: nflverse team-week aggregates, PFR advanced stats, ESPN QBR, injury reports

performance.honest_caveat: The model does not beat the betting market, and its disagreements with the market have historically been wrong more often than right. Presented as analysis, not as betting advice.

epa_per_play.label: EPA / Play
epa_per_play.definition: How many points a team adds, on average, versus what a league-average team would be expected to score from the same down, distance and field position. +0.10 is strong; 0.00 is average; negative means the offence is losing ground.

epa_per_dropback.label: Pass EPA / Dropback
epa_per_dropback.definition: EPA on pass attempts and sacks. Passing efficiency predicts future wins far more reliably than rushing, which is why it carries more weight.

epa_per_rush.label: Rush EPA / Carry
epa_per_rush.definition: EPA on designed runs. Noisier and less predictive than passing EPA.

cpoe.label: CPOE
cpoe.definition: Actual completion rate minus the rate expected given throw depth, pressure and receiver separation. Isolates quarterback accuracy from scheme and difficulty. +3% is very good.

success_proxy.label: First Downs / Play
success_proxy.definition: Share of plays producing a first down — a proxy for play success rate.

sack_rate.label: Sack Rate
sack_rate.definition: How often the offence's dropbacks end in a sack.

turnover_rate.label: Turnover Rate
turnover_rate.definition: Interceptions plus lost fumbles per offensive play.

injury_impact.label: Injury Impact
injury_impact.definition: A single score for who a team is missing, weighting each absence by position and by how likely the player is to sit. The weights are fitted from 2,173 games, not assumed: quarterback absences cost about 2.6 points of margin and skill-position absences about 0.7, while offensive line, defensive line, linebacker and secondary absences are statistically indistinguishable from zero. League average is about 2.0; above 4.0 is a heavily depleted roster.

explosive_pass_rate.label: Explosive Pass Rate
explosive_pass_rate.definition: How often the passing game produces a 20-yard-plus gain.

steps.title: Team-game panel
steps.body: Every team-game since 1999 is assembled with its own offence and, mirrored from the opponent, its defence.

steps.title: Rolling form
steps.body: Each metric is smoothed with a 10-game exponentially weighted average so recent games matter more than old ones.

steps.title: Leakage guard
steps.body: Every rolling feature is shifted one game before smoothing, so a prediction for a game can only ever use games played before it.

steps.title: Matchup interactions
steps.body: A team's offensive EPA is paired against the specific defence it faces, rather than compared to league average.

steps.title: Situational context
steps.body: Rest days, bye weeks, injuries, venue, weather and the opponent's base defensive front are encoded as categorical inputs.

steps.title: Walk-forward validation
steps.body: The model is only ever tested on seasons later than the ones it trained on — never a random split.
